versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2 of toby-adaptive-suite

- No file changes detected; behavior and features remain consistent with the previous version.
- Continues to provide adaptive support for coding, business analysis, project management, web and data development, and NAS metadata scraping.
- Maintains integration with SkillBoss API Hub for resource discovery and open-source recommendations.
- Ensures reliable, adaptable, and user-context-aware guidance across supported domains.

- Updated SkillBoss API Hub endpoint from `https://api.heybossai.com/v1/pilot` to `https://api.skillboss.co/v1/pilot` in the setup instructions.
- No other feature or functionality changes.
